tiers.name: Foundation Rebuild
tiers.description: Enterprise-grade foundation: tooling, contacts, auth, RBAC, validation, audit trail. Must complete before feature modules.

stories.title: Project tooling — ESLint + Vitest + root .gitignore
acceptanceCriteria: ESLint configured for client/ with eslint-plugin-react and eslint-plugin-react-hooks (flat config)
ESLint configured for server/ with Node.js rules (flat config)
Vitest configured for client/ with jsdom environment and @testing-library/react
Vitest configured for server/ with node environment
package.json scripts added: 'test' and 'lint' in both client/ and server/
One smoke test per side to prove tooling works (e.g., health endpoint returns 200, utility function test)
Pre-existing code passes lint with zero errors (fix issues or add targeted ignores)
bash ralph.sh verify passes: lint + test + build all green
Coverage reporting enabled (initially 0% threshold — raised per module later)

stories.title: Secure .env files + create .env.example templates
acceptanceCriteria: .env files removed from git tracking (git rm --cached)
Root .gitignore covers .env, .env.local, .env.*.local
client/.env.example created with placeholder values for VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VITE_API_URL
server/.env.example created with placeholder values for SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, PORT, email recipients
README section added documenting required environment variables
Actual .env files remain on disk (not deleted) so dev environment keeps working

stories.title: Contacts table — independent customer records
acceptanceCriteria: contacts table created via migration: id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, address, city, province, postal_code, driver_license, employer, preferred_language (default 'fr'), source, customer_since, lifetime_deals, lifetime_value, marketing_consent, consent_date, search_vector, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
deal_parties join table created: deal_id, contact_id, role (buyer/cosigner)
deals.contact_id FK column added pointing to contacts
CRUD API: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/contacts with proper error handling
Duplicate detection on phone + email before create (return existing match)
Full-text search endpoint: GET /api/contacts/search?q= using search_vector
Frontend: Contacts page with filter bar, search, and contact cards
Frontend: Contact detail page with properties | timeline | deals layout
Data migration: existing customer_name on deals parsed into first_name/last_name on contacts
All new UI strings added to both en.json and fr.json
Tests: CRUD operations, duplicate detection, search, migration script

stories.title: Stores table — multi-store scoping
acceptanceCriteria: stores table created via migration: id, name, province, tax_rate, address, phone, hours, holiday_calendar, aging_threshold, safety_overdue_days, funding_overdue_days, bill_of_sale_system, esign_platform, created_at, updated_at
Kia Mont-Laurier seeded as store #1 with Quebec tax rate (14.975%)
store_id column added to deals, salespeople, commissions, delivery_checklists, dispatch, sourced_units
All existing records backfilled with store_id = store #1 via migration
scopeToStore() middleware auto-filters queries by user's assigned store
Owner role bypasses store scoping (sees all stores)
API: GET /api/stores, GET /api/stores/:id
Tests: store scoping middleware, data isolation between stores

stories.title: Supabase Auth + RBAC with 10 roles
acceptanceCriteria: Login page uses Supabase Auth (email + password) instead of plain text email
JWT tokens with automatic refresh replace localStorage-only session
users table has role column: owner, gm, sales_manager, fi_manager, salesperson, bdc_agent, service_advisor, driver, accounting, admin
authenticateUser middleware validates JWT on every API call (except health check)
requireRole(...roles) middleware enforces role-based access per route
Salesperson can only see own deals, own commissions, own tasks
GM/Owner can see all data within their store
Admin can create user accounts (no self-registration)
Existing Login.jsx component updated to use Supabase Auth flow
Tests: auth flow, role enforcement, unauthorized access blocked

stories.title: Input validation with Zod schemas
acceptanceCriteria: Zod installed as dependency in server/
Zod schemas created for all existing API endpoints: deals, contacts, salespeople, deliveryChecklists, dispatch, sourcedUnits, email, upload
VIN validation: 17 chars, no I/O/Q, check digit algorithm
Phone normalization: strip formatting, validate 10-11 digits
Postal code: Canadian format validation (A1A 1A1)
Money fields: non-negative integers (cents after F-007, dollars until then)
validate() middleware created and applied to all mutation routes (POST/PUT/PATCH)
Clear, user-friendly error messages returned on validation failure
Tests: valid inputs pass, invalid inputs rejected with correct error messages

stories.title: Soft deletes + financial precision (integer cents)
acceptanceCriteria: deleted_at timestamp column added to all existing tables via migration
All existing queries updated to filter WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
Soft-deleted records visible to GM/Owner with ?include_deleted=true query param
Restore endpoint: PUT /api/<resource>/:id/restore sets deleted_at = null
Money columns migrated from numeric (dollars) to integer (cents) via migration
Migration script converts existing data: value * 100, rounded
formatCurrency(cents) utility created in client for display (divides by 100, adds $ and comma formatting)
parseCurrency(display) utility for form inputs (converts display string to cents)
Commission calculations in deals.js updated for integer math
All report generation updated for cents-based calculations
Tests: soft delete/restore, currency conversion, commission math with cents

stories.title: Activity events — audit trail
acceptanceCriteria: activity_events table created: id, entity_type, entity_id, action, actor_id, old_value (jsonb), new_value (jsonb), metadata (jsonb), created_at
activityLogger middleware auto-logs all mutations (create, update, delete) with before/after values
API: GET /api/activity-events?entity_type=deal&entity_id=:id with pagination
Timeline component displays chronological events with actor name, action, timestamp
Timeline integrated into DealDetail page and Contact detail page
Stage changes, document uploads, email sends, commission changes all logged
Tests: events created on mutations, timeline API returns correct events

stories.title: Global search — Ctrl+K command palette
acceptanceCriteria: Ctrl+K opens search modal overlay from any page
Searches contacts, deals, and vehicles simultaneously via API
Type-ahead with 200ms debounce
Partial matching on phone, VIN (last 8), stock number, customer name
Results categorized by type (Contact, Deal, Vehicle) with icons
Keyboard navigation: arrow keys + Enter to select
Escape closes modal, clicking result navigates to detail page
Search endpoint: GET /api/search?q= returns unified results
Tests: search returns correct results across entity types, keyboard nav works

stories.title: Tasks and follow-ups system
acceptanceCriteria: tasks table created: id, title, description, assignee_id, due_date, priority (low/medium/high/urgent), type (call/email/meeting/follow_up/delivery/other), status (pending/in_progress/completed/cancelled), entity_type, entity_id, recurring_interval, store_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
CRUD API: POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/tasks with filtering by status, assignee, due date
My Tasks widget on Dashboard showing overdue (red), today (yellow), upcoming (default)
Quick-create button from deal detail and contact detail pages
Auto-overdue detection: tasks past due_date automatically flagged
Recurring task support: when completed, auto-creates next instance based on interval
Tests: CRUD, overdue detection, recurring creation, dashboard widget

stories.title: Notification bell + real-time alerts
acceptanceCriteria: notifications table created: id, type, title, body, target_user_id, urgency (low/medium/high), acknowledged, acknowledged_at, entity_type, entity_id, store_id, created_at
Bell icon in top bar shows unread count badge (real-time via Supabase subscription)
Dropdown panel lists notifications with mark-as-read and mark-all-as-read
Three urgency levels with visual distinction (high = red, medium = yellow, low = default)
Auto-generated notifications: deal stage change, task overdue, task assigned, new deal created
API: GET /api/notifications, PUT /api/notifications/:id/acknowledge
Tests: notification creation, real-time count update, acknowledge flow

stories.title: Commission clawback + bulk operations
acceptanceCriteria: Clawback status field on deals: none, flagged, reversed
Clawback initiation restricted to owner/gm/fi_manager roles
Commission reversal calculation logged with reason, original amount, reversed amount
Affected salesperson and their manager notified via notification system
Clawback column visible in commission reports
Bulk select on deal list: change stage, reassign salesperson (up to 50 at once)
Bulk select on task list: mark complete, reassign (up to 50 at once)
Each bulk action validates permissions per item (can't reassign deals you don't own)
Tests: clawback flow, commission reversal math, bulk operations with permission checks

tiers.name: Core Feature Modules
tiers.description: Primary dealership workflows. Depends on Tier 0 foundation completion.

stories.title: Deal Pipeline — Kanban view with drag-drop stages
acceptanceCriteria: 10-stage Kanban board rendered with columns using @hello-pangea/dnd
Deal cards show: customer name, vehicle, value, aging indicator, funding badge
Drag-drop moves deals between stages with transition rules enforced
Funding status runs as parallel track (badge, not a stage)
Board view + list view toggle
Lost reason modal required when moving to Lost stage
Real-time updates via Supabase subscription
Stage-specific actions (e.g., mark funded, schedule delivery)
Tests: stage transitions, drag-drop, funding badge logic

stories.title: Inventory Command Center — vehicle cards + photo gallery + aging
acceptanceCriteria: Vehicle cards with photo, status badge, age indicator, key details
6-status pipeline: at_source, in_transit, incoming, at_garage, on_lot, delivered
Photo gallery with upload, reorder, and primary photo selection
Aging alerts: yellow at threshold, red at 2x threshold (configurable per store)
Filter/sort by status, age, make/model, price range
New DB columns on deals: trim, mileage, acquisition_type, transport_cost, recon_cost, list_price, safety_status, photo_count
vehicle_photos table for gallery
Tests: status transitions, aging calculations, photo upload

stories.title: Garage / Work Orders — safety workflow + recon tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Work orders table with vehicle, type (safety/recon/detail), status, assigned_to, estimated_cost, actual_cost
Safety inspection workflow: pending → in_progress → passed/failed/conditional
Recon tracking with line items and cost rollup
Garage queue dashboard showing pending/in-progress work orders
Integration with inventory status (vehicle moves to at_garage when work order created)
Tests: work order CRUD, status transitions, cost calculations

stories.title: Pre-Delivery Checklist — expand to full PDI
acceptanceCriteria: Expand from 4 items to full PDI checklist (15-20 items per spec)
Section grouping: exterior, interior, mechanical, documents, accessories
Photo proof for key items (damage, odometer, VIN plate)
Compliance percentage shown per deal
Manager sign-off required before delivery can proceed
Tests: checklist completion, compliance calculation, sign-off flow

stories.title: Driver Dispatch — ETA tracking + driver assignment
acceptanceCriteria: Driver assignment to dispatch jobs (name, phone, vehicle)
ETA tracking with estimated departure/arrival times
Status updates: assigned → departed → arrived → completed
SMS notification to customer with ETA (via Resend or Twilio)
Calendar view of scheduled dispatches
Tests: assignment flow, status transitions, ETA calculations

stories.title: Document Manager — library + categorization + templates
acceptanceCriteria: documents table: id, deal_id, contact_id, category, filename, storage_path, uploaded_by, created_at
Document categories: bill_of_sale, credit_app, insurance, registration, trade_docs, other
Upload with drag-drop and category selection
Document library view per deal and per contact
Required documents checklist per deal stage
Tests: upload, categorization, required docs validation

stories.title: Finance Desk — lender tracking + rate shopping
acceptanceCriteria: lenders table: id, name, contact_info, rate_sheet_url, turnaround_days, approval_criteria
deal_submissions table: deal_id, lender_id, status (submitted/approved/declined/conditional), rate, term, conditions
Finance desk view showing all pending submissions per deal
Submit to multiple lenders, track responses
Rate comparison view for F&I manager
Approval workflow: conditional → documents → funded
Tests: submission CRUD, status tracking, rate comparison

stories.title: Funding Tracker — bank-side status + proof workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Funding status on deals: not_submitted, submitted, approved, docs_sent, funded, issue
Funding dashboard showing all deals by funding status
Aging alerts for deals stuck in submitted/approved too long
Proof of funding upload (cheque image, wire confirmation)
Tests: status transitions, aging alerts, proof upload

stories.title: Wholesale Manager — board + auction tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Wholesale deals board (separate from retail pipeline)
Auction listing: vehicle, reserve price, auction house, date, result
Wholesale buyer contacts and history
Profit/loss tracking per wholesale deal
Tests: wholesale CRUD, auction tracking, P&L calculations

stories.title: Notifications & Automation — alert engine + rules
acceptanceCriteria: Automation rules engine: trigger (event) → condition → action
Built-in rules: safety overdue → notify service, funding overdue → notify F&I, aging vehicle → notify manager
Custom rule builder for GM/Owner
Escalation chains: if not acknowledged in 10min → manager, 30min → GM
Email + in-app notification channels
Notification center page with history and filters
Tests: rule evaluation, escalation timing, multi-channel delivery

stories.title: Reporting & Analytics — GM dashboards + custom builder
acceptanceCriteria: GM dashboard: daily/weekly/monthly deal volume, revenue, gross profit
Salesperson leaderboard with real-time rankings
Inventory aging report with cost exposure
Custom report builder: select metrics, date range, grouping, export
Scheduled report delivery via email (weekly summary to GM)
Tests: report calculations, date range filtering, export formats

tiers.name: Advanced Modules
tiers.description: Net-new capabilities. Depends on Tier 1 core modules.

stories.title: Lead Manager — capture, scoring, assignment
acceptanceCriteria: leads table: id, contact_id, source, score, status, assigned_to, created_at
Lead capture from website form, phone call log, walk-in
Lead scoring: recency, engagement, vehicle interest, credit tier
Auto-assignment: round-robin to available salespeople
Lead pipeline view (separate from deal pipeline)
Convert lead to deal with one click (pre-fills contact and vehicle)
Tests: scoring algorithm, auto-assignment, lead-to-deal conversion

stories.title: Chatbot Engine — automated customer engagement
acceptanceCriteria: Chat widget embeddable on dealership website
Automated responses for common questions (hours, inventory, financing)
Lead capture from chat conversations
Handoff to human when bot can't answer
Chat history stored and linked to contact record
Bilingual support (FR/EN) with auto-detection
Tests: bot response matching, lead capture, human handoff trigger
